entries.bcecd2dd810eb3b7: The group consists of the company (SANKO METAL INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.), four unconsolidated subsidiaries and one other affiliated company. Its main businesses are the roofing business and the building materials business, and it also sells electricity generated by solar power. The head office is located in Minato-ku, Tokyo. The number of employees of the reporting company is 520 (as of March 31, 2026). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥47,058 million.
entries.bff81d5f77160e37: In sales, it focuses on strengthening design-in sales centered on technical proposals, and aims to expand orders by introducing competitive products and construction methods to the market. In construction, against the background of a high level of order backlog, it will reliably execute construction work, and work on passing through cost increases for materials, labor, logistics, facilities and other items to prices and on further cost reduction. Over the medium to long term, it sets forth that, by newly establishing a Quality Control Department in April 2026 to improve "construction quality" and "manufacturing quality" and advancing improvement of on-site productivity, it will create a virtuous cycle through "industry-leading levels of product capabilities, sales capabilities and construction capabilities." It is also advancing initiatives under its Medium-Term Management Policy (2024-2026).
